name: OffshorePobManifestManager
tagline: Personnel on board, helicopter manifests, beds, certificates and muster – one drop-in Power Platform app.
description: A complete offshore personnel-on-board app for Power Apps and Power Pages: live POB against the certified limit, helicopter and vessel manifests with seat and payload checks, BOSIET / offshore medical / HUET validity for every trip, bed allocation with back-to-back sharing, lifeboat muster drills and a 14-day crew-change forecast. Works instantly with demo data, then binds to any table in a few clicks.
features: Helicopter seat and payload (body + baggage) checks
Certificate validity for the whole trip
Bed clash detection with Day/Night sharing
Live muster drill with accounted / missing
